import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Task939F {

    static class FastScanner {
        private final InputStream in;
        private final byte[] buffer = new byte[0x10000];
        private int ptr = 0;
        private int len = 0;

        public FastScanner() {
            in = System.in;
        }

        private int read() throws IOException {
            if (ptr >= len) {
                len = in.read(buffer);
                ptr = 0;
                if (len <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[ptr++];
        }

        private int skip() throws IOException {
            int c;
            while ((c = read()) <= 32 && c != -1) {}
            return c;
        }

        public int nextInt() throws IOException {
            int c = skip();
            if (c == -1) throw new EOFException();
            int sign = 1;
            if (c == '-') {
                sign = -1;
                c = read();
            }
            int val = 0;
            while (c > 32) {
                val = val * 10 + c - '0';
                c = read();
            }
            return val * sign;
        }
    }

    static int[] kbeg, kend;
    static int n, k;
    static int minRotates;

    static void updateMin(int val) {
        if (minRotates == 0) minRotates = val;
        else minRotates = Math.min(minRotates, val);
    }

    static void dfs(int side, int[] tmin, int[] tmax, int curPos, int idx, boolean inInterval) {
        if (tmin[0] > n || tmin[1] > n) return;
        else if ((tmin[0] <= n && tmax[0] >= n) || (tmin[1] <= n && tmax[1] >= n)) {
            if ((tmax[0] < n && side == 1) || (tmax[1] < n && side == 0)) {
                updateMin(curRotates + 1);
            } else {
                updateMin(curRotates);
            }
            return;
        } else if (idx == k) return;

        if (inInterval) {
            if (kbeg[idx] == kend[idx]) {
                dfs(side, tmin, tmax, curPos, idx + 1, false);
                curRotates++;
                dfs(1 - side, tmin, tmax, curPos, idx + 1, false);
                curRotates--;
            } else {
                // no rotate
                tmin[side] += kend[idx] - kbeg[idx];
                tmax[side] += kend[idx] - kbeg[idx];
                dfs(side, tmin, tmax, kend[idx], idx + 1, false);
                tmin[side] -= kend[idx] - kbeg[idx];
                tmax[side] -= kend[idx] - kbeg[idx];

                // rotate once
                tmax[side] += kend[idx] - kbeg[idx];
                tmax[1 - side] += kend[idx] - kbeg[idx];
                curRotates++;
                dfs(1 - side, tmin, tmax, kend[idx], idx + 1, false);
                curRotates--;
                tmax[side] -= kend[idx] - kbeg[idx];
                tmax[1 - side] -= kend[idx] - kbeg[idx];

                // rotate twice
                tmax[side] += kend[idx] - kbeg[idx];
                tmin[1 - side] += 1;
                tmax[1 - side] += kend[idx] - kbeg[idx] - 1;
                curRotates += 2;
                dfs(side, tmin, tmax, kend[idx], idx + 1, false);
                curRotates -= 2;
                tmax[side] -= kend[idx] - kbeg[idx];
                tmin[1 - side] -= 1;
                tmax[1 - side] -= kend[idx] - kbeg[idx] - 1;
            }
        } else {
            int delta = kbeg[idx] - curPos;
            tmin[side] += delta;
            tmax[side] += delta;
            dfs(side, tmin, tmax, kbeg[idx], idx, true);
            tmin[side] -= delta;
            tmax[side] -= delta;
        }
    }

    static int curRotates = 0;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        FastScanner fs = new FastScanner();
        n = fs.nextInt();
        k = fs.nextInt();
        kbeg = new int[k];
        kend = new int[k];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            kbeg[i] = fs.nextInt();
            kend[i] = fs.nextInt();
        }
        int[] tmin = new int[2];
        int[] tmax = new int[2];
        minRotates = 0;
        dfs(0, tmin, tmax, 0, 0, false);
        if (minRotates > 0) {
            System.out.println("Full");
            System.out.println(minRotates);
        } else {
            System.out.println("Hungry");
        }
    }
}

    static class InputReader {
        private final InputStream stream;
        private final byte[] buf = new byte[8192];
        private int curChar, numChars;

        public InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        private int read() throws IOException {
            if (numChars == -1) throw new IOException();
            if (curChar >= numChars) {
                curChar = 0;
                numChars = stream.read(buf);
                if (numChars <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buf[curChar++];
        }

        public int nextInt() throws IOException {
            int c = read();
            while (c <= 32) c = read();
            int sgn = 1;
            if (c == '-') {
                sgn = -1;
                c = read();
            }
            int res = 0;
            while (c > 32) {
                res = res * 10 + c - '0';
                c = read();
            }
            return res * sgn;
        }
    }

    static int N, K;
    static int[] L, R;
    static int minAnswer;

    static void record(int x) {
        if (minAnswer == 0) minAnswer = x;
        else minAnswer = Math.min(minAnswer, x);
    }

    static void traverse(int side, int[] low, int[] high, int cur, int pos, boolean inside) {
        if (low[0] > N || low[1] > N) return;
        if ((low[0] <= N && high[0] >= N) || (low[1] <= N && high[1] >= N)) {
            if ((high[0] < N && side == 1) || (high[1] < N && side == 0)) {
                record(rotCount + 1);
            } else {
                record(rotCount);
            }
            return;
        }
        if (pos == K) return;

        if (inside) {
            if (L[pos] == R[pos]) {
                traverse(side, low, high, cur, pos + 1, false);
                rotCount++;
                traverse(1 - side, low, high, cur, pos + 1, false);
                rotCount--;
            } else {
                int span = R[pos] - L[pos];

                // no rotation
                low[side] += span;
                high[side] += span;
                traverse(side, low, high, R[pos], pos + 1, false);
                low[side] -= span;
                high[side] -= span;

                // one rotation
                high[side] += span;
                high[1 - side] += span;
                rotCount++;
                traverse(1 - side, low, high, R[pos], pos + 1, false);
                rotCount--;
                high[side] -= span;
                high[1 - side] -= span;

                // two rotations
                high[side] += span;
                low[1 - side] += 1;
                high[1 - side] += span - 1;
                rotCount += 2;
                traverse(side, low, high, R[pos], pos + 1, false);
                rotCount -= 2;
                high[side] -= span;
                low[1 - side] -= 1;
                high[1 - side] -= span - 1;
            }
        } else {
            int diff = L[pos] - cur;
            low[side] += diff;
            high[side] += diff;
            traverse(side, low, high, L[pos], pos, true);
            low[side] -= diff;
            high[side] -= diff;
        }
    }

    static int rotCount = 0;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {

        N = in.nextInt();
        K = in.nextInt();
        L = new int[K];
        R = new int[K];
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            L[i] = in.nextInt();
            R[i] = in.nextInt();

import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Task939F {

    static class Input {
        private final DataInputStream dis;
        private final byte[] buffer = new byte[1 << 16];
        private int bufferPointer, bytesRead;

        public Input(InputStream in) {
            dis = new DataInputStream(in);
        }

        private void fillBuffer() throws IOException {
            bytesRead = dis.read(buffer, 0, buffer.length);
            bufferPointer = 0;
        }

        private byte read() throws IOException {
            if (bufferPointer == bytesRead) fillBuffer();
            return buffer[bufferPointer++];
        }

        public int nextInt() throws IOException {
            byte c = read();
            while (c <= ' ') c = read();
            boolean neg = (c == '-');
            if (neg) c = read();
            int val = 0;
            while (c > ' ') {
                val = (val << 3) + (val << 1) + (c - '0');
                c = read();
            }
            return neg ? -val : val;
        }
    }

    static int N, K;
    static int[] A, B;
    static int bestAnswer;

    static void updateBest(int rotations) {
        if (bestAnswer == 0) bestAnswer = rotations;
        else bestAnswer = Math.min(bestAnswer, rotations);
    }

    static void solve(int side, int[] minVal, int[] maxVal, int cur, int idx, boolean inRange) {
        if (minVal[0] > N || minVal[1] > N) return;
        if ((minVal[0] <= N && maxVal[0] >= N) || (minVal[1] <= N && maxVal[1] >= N)) {
            if ((maxVal[0] < N && side == 1) || (maxVal[1] < N && side == 0)) {
                updateBest(currentRotations + 1);
            } else {
                updateBest(currentRotations);
            }
            return;
        }
        if (idx == K) return;

        if (inRange) {
            if (A[idx] == B[idx]) {
                solve(side, minVal, maxVal, cur, idx + 1, false);
                currentRotations++;
                solve(1 - side, minVal, maxVal, cur, idx + 1, false);
                currentRotations--;
            } else {
                int span = B[idx] - A[idx];

                // no rotate
                minVal[side] += span;
                maxVal[side] += span;
                solve(side, minVal, maxVal, B[idx], idx + 1, false);
                minVal[side] -= span;
                maxVal[side] -= span;

                // rotate once
                maxVal[side] += span;
                maxVal[1 - side] += span;
                currentRotations++;
                solve(1 - side, minVal, maxVal, B[idx], idx + 1, false);
                currentRotations--;
                maxVal[side] -= span;
                maxVal[1 - side] -= span;

                // rotate twice
                maxVal[side] += span;
                minVal[1 - side] += 1;
                maxVal[1 - side] += span - 1;
                currentRotations += 2;
                solve(side, minVal, maxVal, B[idx], idx + 1, false);
                currentRotations -= 2;
                maxVal[side] -= span;
                minVal[1 - side] -= 1;
                maxVal[1 - side] -= span - 1;
            }
        } else {
            int shift = A[idx] - cur;
            minVal[side] += shift;
            maxVal[side] += shift;
            solve(side, minVal, maxVal, A[idx], idx, true);
            minVal[side] -= shift;
            maxVal[side] -= shift;
        }
    }

    static int currentRotations = 0;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Input in = new Input(System.in);
        N = in.nextInt();
        K = in.nextInt();
        A = new int[K];
        B = new int[K];
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            A[i] = in.nextInt();
            B[i] = in.nextInt();

        bestAnswer = 0;

            System.out.println("Full");
            System.out.println(bestAnswer);
